name: Native-denominated volume expansion
hypothesis: Buy a token/native breakout only when native-unit net buying also exceeds its historical baseline.
spec: Setup: USD volume can rise mechanically with the native coin. Entry: Buy a token/native breakout only when native-unit net buying also exceeds its historical baseline. Evaluate only information available at decision time; attempt execution afterward. Exit: Exit on native-unit flow reversal or breakout failure. Always apply the earlier of the registered maximum holding time and hard risk invalidation; fills can be delayed or unavailable. Parameters to pre-register: eligible universe and point-in-time membership, observation window and completed-event/bar rule, numerical threshold(s) named by the signal, entry order and maximum price/quote deviation, initial invalidation level and target if used, H_max and explicit session definition, cost, impact, latency, failed-attempt, and leg-risk models, position/notional/exit-capacity caps, baseline and out-of-sample rejection thresholds.
blocked_reason: needs deduplicated swap-level flow history; exchange aggressor flow is captured live only
